fact: The Office of the Prime Minister said in March 2023 that it provides information technology support to all Offices, Ministries and Agencies and leads the design, programming and hosting of government online services, with funding for infrastructure at the Government Data Centre.
title: Motivation for Budget Allocation for Vote 02: Office of the Prime Minister on the Appropriation Bill, 2023
publisher: Office of the Prime Minister, Republic of Namibia
